components.name: InwardFormPage
components.purpose: Server component wrapper hosting the InwardForm client component. Sets page title + breadcrumb.

components.name: InwardForm
components.purpose: Inward entry form — date, supplier (auto-fills place), entered_by, design, line rows per active grade. Submits POST /api/v1/inward; redirects on success.
state: react-hook-form: { purchase_date, supplier_id, entered_by_id, design_id (form-local, drives line rows), lines: { design_id, grade_id, nos? }[] }
interactions: On supplier select → form.setValue('supplier_id', id) + display supplier.place in read-only div (AC-022)
On design select → useQuery enabled, fetch grades for that design; replace lines field-array with one row per grade
On line nos change → form.setValue('lines[i].nos', value)

On submit → zod validation → strip lines where nos == null/0 → if 0 valid lines, surface inline error 'at least one line with nos > 0 required' (AC-026) → mutation.mutateAsync(payload) → toast success → router.push('/inward/new') with reset; on error → toast with detail

rules: purchase_date: z.date().refine(d => d <= today, 'cannot be in the future' [ERR-001]).refine(d => d >= subDays(today, 7), 'cannot be older than 7 days' [ERR-002])
supplier_id: z.number().int().positive()
entered_by_id: z.number().int().positive()

lines: z.array(z.object({ design_id, grade_id, nos: z.number().int().nullable().refine(n => n === null || n >= 0, 'nos must be >= 0 [ERR-007]') })).min(1).refine(arr => arr.some(l => l.nos != null && l.nos > 0), 'at least one line with nos > 0 [AC-026]')

components.name: SalesFormPage
components.purpose: Server component wrapper hosting the SalesForm client component.

components.name: SalesForm
components.purpose: Sales entry form — mirror of InwardForm with dealer + 2 required staff (loading + verified). Submits POST /api/v1/sales.
state: react-hook-form: { sales_date, dealer_id, loading_staff_id, verified_by_id, design_id (form-local), lines: { design_id, grade_id, nos? }[] }
interactions: On dealer select → display dealer.place read-only (AC-029)
On design select → fetch grades, populate line rows
On submit → zod validation (both staff required) → strip blank lines → mutation → toast/redirect

rules: sales_date: date refinements identical to inward (ERR-001/ERR-002)
dealer_id: z.number().int().positive()
loading_staff_id: z.number().int().positive()
verified_by_id: z.number().int().positive()
lines: same shape as inward; min 1 valid line

components.name: AdjustmentForm
components.purpose: Stock-adjustment form — single design header, stock_date + entry_date, software_cb pre-populated per grade via getGradesWithCb. Live difference = physical_cb − software_cb display. ERR-012 banner if design has no active grades.
state: react-hook-form: { stock_date, entry_date, design_id, entered_by_id, lines: { grade_id, software_cb (snapshot, hidden), physical_cb }[] }
useQuery(getGradesWithCb, enabled: design_id && stock_date) — fetches projection [{grade_id, grade_code, software_cb}]
interactions: On design select + stock_date set → useQuery enabled with both args → on success: if [] → show ERR-012 banner + disable submit (AC-040 / TC-102); if populated → populate lines field-array with one row per response item, pre-fill software_cb as read-only display (TC-099)
On physical_cb input change → form watches the row → live-compute difference = physical_cb - software_cb and render as adjacent read-only field (TC-101)
On submit → zod validation (stock_date <= entry_date cross-field; physical_cb >= 0 per row) → omit software_cb from payload (server snapshots fresh) → mutation → toast/redirect

rules: stock_date: z.date()
entry_date: z.date()
design_id: z.number().int().positive()
entered_by_id: z.number().int().positive()
lines: z.array(z.object({ grade_id: z.number().positive(), physical_cb: z.number().int().nonnegative('physical_cb must be >= 0 [ERR-009]') })).min(1)
Cross-field: .refine(d => d.stock_date <= d.entry_date, { message: 'stock_date must be on or before entry_date [ERR-010]', path: ['entry_date'] })

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: Date picker wrapping shadcn Calendar + Popover. Used by all 3 forms. Accepts min/max date for client-side bound enforcement.
interactions: click to open calendar; pick date closes popover and fires onChange
components.notes: Built on shadcn calendar.tsx (S1 — TD-001 patched for react-day-picker v10).

components.name: MasterSelect
components.purpose: Generic async Select dropdown for picking a single master row (supplier, dealer, staff, design). Shows display name; binds id to form state.
props: options: { id: number; label: string; sublabel?: string }[]
interactions: click trigger → list opens → click option → onChange(id) + close

components.name: TransactionLineRow
components.purpose: Reusable line row for Inward and Sales — grade_code (read) + nos input (controlled). Maps form.lines[i].nos.
components.state: controlled by parent's react-hook-form field array

components.name: AdjustmentLineRow
components.purpose: Per-grade row for Adjustment form. Displays grade_code + software_cb (read-only) + physical_cb (input) + difference (live-computed read-only).
components.state: uses watch() on lines[i].physical_cb to compute difference live

components.name: Err012Banner
components.purpose: Inline alert shown above the AdjustmentForm body when getGradesWithCb returns []. Blocks submit. Visible to screen readers via role='alert'.

api_layer.purpose: Single integration boundary. Components/hooks import from here only. During /ases-ui-scaffold this is the ONE file Sonnet may rewrite — initially returns mocks, post-integration calls real backend.
exports: inwardApi: { create(payload: InwardCreate): Promise<InwardRead>; list(filters?: { date_from?, date_to? }): Promise<InwardRead[]> }
salesApi: { create(payload: SalesCreate): Promise<SalesRead>; list(filters?: { date_from?, date_to?, dealer_ids?, design_ids? }): Promise<SalesRead[]> }
designsApi.getGradesWithCb(designId: number, stockDate: string): Promise<DesignGradeReadWithCb[]>  // ADD to existing S1 designsApi
// S1 reused: suppliersApi.list(), dealersApi.list(), staffApi.list(), designsApi.list(), designsApi.getGrades()

mocks_layer.purpose: Seed data driving UI-only unit tests + scaffold preview. Replaced/deleted at integration time. Components NEVER import from mocks.ts directly — only api.ts.
exports: mockSuppliers: SupplierRead[] (3 rows — Manjunatha/Mallur, Ramesh/Belgaum, Inactive Co./Hubli)
mockGradesForDesign: Record<number, GradeReadMin[]>  // S1 contract: {grade_id, grade_code}
throwApiError(status, detail) — helper used in TC tests to assert 422/404 paths

types_layer.purpose: TypeScript types mirroring backend Pydantic schemas (T-046). Single source of truth for frontend.

schemas_layer.purpose: Zod schemas for client-side validation. Resolve via @hookform/resolvers/zod into react-hook-form. Backend re-validates in T-046 — these are UX-level not security-level.

hooks_layer.purpose: TanStack Query wrappers for transaction-specific calls. Master hooks (useSuppliers, useDealers, useStaff, useDesigns) reused from S1.
exports: useGradesForDesign(designId: number | undefined) — wraps designsApi.getGrades; enabled: !!designId
useGradesWithCb(designId: number | undefined, stockDate: string | undefined) — wraps designsApi.getGradesWithCb; enabled: !!(designId && stockDate)

navigation.placement: Nav sidebar's Transactions section (created in this sprint). Master CRUD pages from S1 remain in Masters section.

layout_rules: Mobile: single-column form; line table collapses into stacked cards (one card per grade row showing label + input pair)
Tablet: 2-column header grid (e.g., date + supplier on top, place + staff below); line table as horizontal table
Desktop: 2-column header grid expanded; line table is a wide 4-column table (grade | nos input | ... ); submit button right-aligned
Sticky submit-bar at bottom on mobile to keep CTA visible while scrolling line rows

rules: Every <Label htmlFor=> ↔ <Input id=> pair correctly wired (shadcn primitives already follow this)

Validation errors surface via

adjacent to the input, with aria-describedby on the input pointing to the error id
Required fields use aria-required='true'
DatePicker exposes the calendar via aria-label and supports keyboard navigation (shadcn calendar already supports this)
Submit button announces busy state via aria-busy when mutation is pending
ERR-012 banner uses role='alert' so screen readers announce it on appearance
Live-computed 'difference' in AdjustmentLineRow uses aria-live='polite' so screen readers announce updates without interrupting typing
Color is NOT the only indicator of validation state — use icon (lucide AlertCircle) + text label

patterns: Reuse S1's jest.setup.ts for jsdom polyfills (scrollIntoView etc. — UR-W004/005)
Form submission tests use userEvent (await) to simulate typing + selecting; assert on toast / redirect / disabled-submit state
